title: Power squeeze reshapes Asia's data centre boom
lede: The defining thread of the week was electricity: across Asia-Pacific, securing power has overtaken land as the primary constraint on data centre development. In Malaysia, DayOne moved to line up as much as 1.5GW of on-site generation and battery storage with utility Tenaga Nasional Berhad for a planned Selangor campus, a signal that large operators increasingly expect to supply their own power rather than wait on grids. Australia went further, with its energy regulator recommending that big data centers self-generate clean, firm power and pay full network connection costs. Singapore, meanwhile, awarded 50MW of new capacity under strict sustainability conditions while repositioning itself as the region's premium tier as Johor and Batam absorb scale demand. Capital remained abundant: KKR and Singtel completed their takeover of STT GDC, Keppel and its REIT spent over US$1.1 billion on Tokyo assets, and bids landed for Stack Infrastructure's A$28 billion portfolio. But community backlash over power, water and land spread across Asia, and subsea cable investment surged as operators raced to connect the build-out.

themes.heading: Power becomes the industry's binding constraint
themes.narrative: Energy supply displaced land as the top bottleneck for Asia-Pacific data centre development, with grid queues and substation limits slowing projects. DayOne's twin agreements with Tenaga Nasional Berhad to develop up to 1.5GW of on-site generation and battery storage for a Selangor campus show operators moving toward self-supplied power. In Singapore, energy stakeholders warned that AI-driven data centre demand will strain the city-state's power system.
themes.heading_zh: 电力成为行业发展的制约瓶颈
themes.narrative_zh: 能源供应已取代土地成为亚太地区数据中心发展的首要瓶颈，电网排队和变电站容量限制正在拖慢项目进度。DayOne与Tenaga Nasional Berhad签署了两项协议，为其雪兰莪园区开发最高1.5GW的现场发电和电池储能设施，表明运营商正转向自备电力模式。在新加坡，能源行业人士警告称，AI驱动的数据中心需求将使这个城市国家的电力系统承压。

themes.heading: Singapore plays premium as neighbours take scale
themes.narrative: Singapore awarded 50MW of new capacity to operators including Digital Realty and STT GDC under its tightly controlled, sustainability-conditioned process. The city-state is repositioning as the region's premium tier for high-value, low-latency workloads while Johor and Batam absorb hyperscale demand, though its renewable-energy mandate for new facilities faces practical hurdles. A new liquid cooling standard for tropical climates and data showing Singapore firms captured 98% of US$11.5 billion in regional data centre funding reinforced its hub status.
themes.heading_zh: 新加坡走高端路线，周边国家承接规模化需求
themes.narrative_zh: 新加坡在其严格管控、以可持续性为条件的分配机制下，向包括Digital Realty和STT GDC在内的运营商授予了50MW的新增容量。在Johor和巴淡岛承接hyperscale需求之际，这个城市国家正重新定位为区域内承接高价值、低时延工作负载的高端枢纽，不过其针对新建设施的可再生能源强制要求面临实际障碍。一项面向热带气候的新型液冷标准，以及显示新加坡企业获得区域数据中心融资总额115亿美元中98%份额的数据，进一步巩固了其枢纽地位。

themes.heading: Capital keeps flowing to platforms and pipelines
themes.narrative: KKR and Singtel completed their joint takeover of STT GDC, one of Asia's largest data center platforms, to fund faster AI-ready build-out. DayOne closed a S$530 million green loan from DBS, OCBC and UOB for a Singapore project and sought further borrowing for a Hong Kong facility ahead of a planned US IPO. In Australia, bids landed for Stack Infrastructure's portfolio valued at more than A$28 billion, though Macquarie ultimately passed on the process.
themes.heading_zh: 资本持续流向平台与项目管线
themes.narrative_zh: KKR与Singtel完成了对亚洲最大数据中心平台之一STT GDC的联合收购，以加快AI就绪基础设施的建设融资。DayOne为其新加坡项目从DBS、OCBC和UOB获得了5.3亿新元的绿色贷款，并计划在赴美IPO之前为一处香港设施寻求进一步融资。在澳大利亚，针对Stack Infrastructure估值超过280亿澳元资产的竞购已经提交，不过Macquarie最终退出了这一进程。

themes.heading: Keppel deepens its Tokyo bet
themes.narrative: Keppel acquired a majority stake in two Tokyo data centers while Keppel DC REIT agreed to buy two freehold Japanese facilities for about US$1.1 billion, upsizing its private placement to S$625 million on strong investor demand. Not all observers are convinced: one analysis warned the easy yen-financing trade is over and that Tokyo valuations now carry obsolescence risk. Ada Infrastructure added to the momentum, breaking ground on a new Tokyo facility.
themes.narrative_zh: Keppel收购了两处东京数据中心的多数股权，同时Keppel DC REIT同意以约11亿美元收购两处日本永久产权设施，并因投资者需求强劲将私募配售规模上调至6.25亿新元。并非所有观察者都对此买账：有分析警告称，轻松的日元融资交易时代已经结束，东京的估值如今已包含设备过时风险。Ada Infrastructure进一步助推了这一势头，在东京为一处新设施破土动工。

themes.heading: Backlash and regulation catch up with the boom
themes.narrative: Community opposition to rapid data centre construction spread across Malaysia, Indonesia and India, with residents citing electricity costs, water use and land pressures. Australia's debate intensified around energy shortages, bubble fears and public trust, while its energy regulator recommended requiring large data centers to self-generate clean power and pay full connection costs. Experts argued Australia's AI ambitions hinge on smarter management of energy and water constraints.
themes.heading_zh: 行业热潮遭遇反弹与监管跟进
themes.narrative_zh: 针对数据中心快速建设的社区反对声音在马来西亚、印度尼西亚和印度蔓延，居民们提到了电费、用水和土地压力。澳大利亚的争论围绕能源短缺、泡沫担忧和公众信任不断升级，该国能源监管机构建议要求大型数据中心自建清洁电力并全额承担接入费用。专家认为，澳大利亚的AI雄心取决于对能源和水资源约束的更智能管理。

themes.heading: Subsea cables race to connect AI capacity
themes.narrative: AWS is building a 420Tbps transpacific cable linking Japan to Washington state, the first system to land there in over two decades, engineered for distributed AI traffic. Australian AI infrastructure firm Firmus committed about US$300 million to SUBCO's APX East cable, locking in up to 150Tbps of Australia-US capacity for 25 years. The investment push contrasted with Vietnam, where simultaneous faults on four subsea systems caused fresh nationwide connectivity outages.
themes.heading_zh: 海底电缆竞相连接 AI 算力
themes.narrative_zh: AWS正在建设一条连接日本与华盛顿州的420Tbps跨太平洋海缆，这是二十多年来首条在该州登陆的海缆系统，专为分布式AI流量而设计。澳大利亚AI基础设施公司Firmus向SUBCO的APX East海缆承诺投入约3亿美元，锁定最高150Tbps的澳大利亚至美国容量，为期25年。这股投资热潮与越南形成鲜明对比——后者四条海底光缆系统同时发生故障，造成全国范围的新一轮连接中断。

project_milestones.name: Two freehold data centers in Japan (Keppel DC REIT acquisition)

title_zh: 电力供应紧张重塑亚洲数据中心建设热潮
lede_zh: 本周的主线是电力：在整个亚太地区，电力保障已取代土地成为数据中心发展的首要制约因素。在马来西亚，DayOne 与公用事业公司 Tenaga Nasional Berhad 达成协议，为其规划中的雪兰莪园区配置高达 1.5GW 的现场发电和电池储能设施，这表明大型运营商越来越倾向于自备电力，而非等待电网接入。澳大利亚走得更远，其能源监管机构建议大型数据中心自行生产清洁、稳定的电力，并全额承担并网费用。与此同时，新加坡在严格的可持续发展条件下批出了 50MW 的新增容量，并将自身重新定位为该地区的高端市场层级，而规模型需求则由柔佛和巴淡承接。资本依然充裕：KKR 和
